implemented_capabilities.capability: Blast radius / user-flow impact via reverse dependency traversal
implemented_capabilities.notes: Variable-length Cypher match (dep)-[:CALLS|READS_WRITES|PUBLISHES|CONSUMES*1..6]->(target) with min(length(p)) hops, joined to UserFlow via SERVES. Depth-capped (6) but relies on FalkorDB variable-length pattern semantics rather than a Python BFS.

Ranks components that are transitive dependencies of the alerting set by (covers desc, is_alerting desc, alerting_deps asc, recent merged PRs desc). _validate_findings rejects (once) an LLM root cause that explains fewer alerts than the graph's best candidate - a real graph-consistency guard on the LLM output.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Three-agent on-call team (Triage -> Investigator -> Scribe) handing off via Task nodes
implemented_capabilities.notes: Triage is deterministic (alert grouping + severity from user flows); Investigator is an LLM tool loop over 15+ allowlisted graph tools ending in submit_findings; Scribe writes postmortem Document/Lesson/embedding/SIMILAR_TO. Runs persist as AgentRun->Step(NEXT chain)->TOUCHED nodes so crashed/paused runs resume from the step trail; CLAIM_TASK is a single atomic Cypher claim.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Incident memory with vector recall (past incidents, documents) and graph-boosted scoring
implemented_capabilities.notes: db.idx.vector.queryNodes on Incident/Document embeddings (fastembed, cosine) with score = 0.6*text_sim + 0.3*same_root_cause + 0.1*component_overlap. Requires FalkorDB vector index support.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph algorithm analytics (PageRank criticality, shortest path to user, community clusters, bus factor)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses FalkorDB native procedures algo.pageRank, algo.SPpaths, algo.labelPropagation over a derived DEPENDS_ON edge. FalkorDB-specific; availability of each procedure (esp. labelPropagation, SPpaths args) must be verified on server 4.22 before reuse.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Idempotent outbound actions (page, GitHub issue, Slack/Discord notify)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Each action is an Action node keyed by incident+kind so repeat calls are no-ops; page is only recorded in the graph (no real paging); GitHub/Slack/Discord calls are real urllib POSTs only when env tokens/webhooks are set, otherwise dry_run/skipped.

Webhook parsing and incident grouping are real; simulate_fault derives alerts from the same DEPENDS_ON graph the agent later queries, so the published 8/8 evaluation is on a synthetic OTel-demo topology and is partly circular.

implemented_capabilities.capability: GitHub repo to system-model connector (compose, CODEOWNERS, ADRs, PRs)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure-function parsers (unit-tested) infer components and dependencies from docker-compose depends_on and env hostnames; heuristic, regex-based classification of datastores/brokers.

graph_models_and_cypher: FalkorDB graph per tenant 'org_<tenant>'. Labels: Component (Service/Datastore/Topic subtypes via extra label), Team, Person, PullRequest, Release, Incident, Alert, Finding, Action, Document, Decision, Lesson, Runbook, UserFlow, Scenario (hidden ground truth), AgentRun, Step, Task, Meta. Edges: CALLS, READS_WRITES, PUBLISHES, CONSUMES, DEPENDS_ON (derived), SERVES, OWNS, ON_CALL_FOR, MEMBER_OF, MODIFIES, AUTHORED, INCLUDES, FIRED_ON, TRIGGERED_BY, IMPACTED, ROOT_CAUSE, HAS_FINDING, BLAMES, SUPPORTED_BY, PAGED, HAS_ACTION, RESOLVED_BY, SIMILAR_TO, ABOUT, AFFECTS, MADE, RECORDED_IN, HAS_STEP, NEXT, TOUCHED, INVESTIGATES, WORKED_ON, FOR, PRODUCED. FalkorDB-specific: algo.pageRank, algo.SPpaths, algo.labelPropagation, db.idx.vector.queryNodes with vecf32(), CREATE VECTOR INDEX, db.idx.fulltext.createNodeIndex. No APOC/GDS. Reads use ro_query; values are bound parameters; f-strings only interpolate the module constant DEP and MAX_HOPS (not user input).
algorithms: Reverse variable-length traversal (depth cap 6) with min hop distance for blast radius (queries.py:BLAST_RADIUS)
Coverage-ranked root-cause candidate scoring (queries.py:ROOT_CAUSE_CANDIDATES) plus LLM-answer consistency check (incident_agents.py:_validate_findings)
Hybrid incident similarity: 0.6 vector + 0.3 same root + 0.1 component overlap (queries.py:SIMILAR_INCIDENTS)
PageRank criticality, SPpaths shortest path from user entry point, label propagation clusters (FalkorDB native)
Expertise score: PR count with recency x2 within 30d (queries.py:EXPERTS); bus-factor counting distinct authors
Atomic task claiming via single Cypher SET on oldest open Task (agents/store.py:CLAIM_TASK)
backend_interfaces: FastAPI: GET /api/health, /api/tenants, /api/llm, /api/topology, /api/stats, /api/component/{name}, /api/queries, /api/faults, /api/tenant; POST /api/alerts (Alertmanager webhook), POST /api/connect/github + GET /api/connect/jobs/{id}, POST simulate, GET incidents/incident/{id}, POST resolve, GET run/{id}, POST resume, POST ask

MCP server (blastradius.mcp_server): root_cause_candidates, blast_radius, recent_changes, who_to_page, experts, similar_incidents, past_fixes, path_to_user, criticality, decisions_for, search_docs, component_overview, ask_company_brain
CLI: python -m blastradius.cli / blastradius.eval / blastradius.llm / agents.worker
frontend_interfaces: React/Vite/TS: App, Graph (topology), IncidentPanel, Timeline, ComponentDrawer, AskPanel, ConnectPanel
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Multi-agent handoff through (:Task)-[:FOR]->(:Incident) nodes; persistent step trail (AgentRun/Step/NEXT/TOUCHED) acts as checkpoint so paused/crashed runs rebuild and continue; LLM gateway with provider fallback chain, RPM limiter and cooldown that pauses runs until resume_at; long-term memory = postmortem Document + Lesson + embeddings + SIMILAR_TO links written by the Scribe; Finding SUPPORTED_BY cited entities gives answer provenance.
tests_present: ~48 test functions in 6 files (test_agents 13, test_connectors 10, test_llm_gateway 8, test_queries 8, test_llm_providers 6, test_actions 3). Some tests exercise the graph and need a live FalkorDB; connectors/repo_model parsers are pure. docs/EVALUATION.md reports an 8/8 fault-injection eval run against real LLMs on a synthetic topology.
dependency_requirements: FalkorDB server with vector index + algo procedures
security_findings: blastradius/api.py - no authentication or CORS control on any route, including POST /api/alerts, POST /api/connect/github, POST simulate and resolve; anyone reaching the port can inject alerts, trigger outbound GitHub fetches and write to the graph

blastradius/api.py:~185-205 - /api/connect/github spawns a daemon thread that calls out to GitHub for a user-supplied repo (unrestricted outbound fetch, in-memory _jobs dict, no rate limit); max_prs capped at 300
blastradius/actions.py:~66-76,~102-115 - urllib.request POST to GitHub API and to Slack/Discord webhook URLs read from env; webhook URL deliberately not stored in graph (good), tokens read from env
blastradius/queries.py - f-string Cypher interpolates only module constants (DEP, MAX_HOPS); all user values are bound params (no injection)
.env.example - placeholder entries for GROQ/GEMINI/OPENROUTER/OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/CUSTOM_LLM keys and GITHUB_TOKEN; no real key values observed
No eval/exec/pickle/subprocess in blastradius/; MCP tools and agent tools are allowlisted and component-name validated (agents/tools.py:_check_component)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Directly overlaps blast-radius traversal and RCA families (also 986036734/blastradius and NishaadG/blastradius in the same sweep, patchpath, rootcause-agent). Agent step-trail/handoff overlaps Agent Memory & Provenance repos.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - Finding SUPPORTED_BY cited entities, AgentRun/Step/TOUCHED audit trail, Decision/ADR AFFECTS component, and recent-change correlation give provenance and decision lineage, but there is no supersession, temporal invalidation of facts, or approval gating (actions are auto-executed).

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Compact, parameterized FalkorDB-native Cypher library for reverse-dependency blast radius and graph-ranked root cause with a consistency check on LLM output, plus a proven AgentRun/Step/Task graph schema for resumable multi-agent handoff.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (vector index + algo.* procedures); fastembed model for similarity; LLM key only for the Investigator/Scribe agents

strategy_rationale: The blast-radius and root-cause Cypher patterns map directly onto Kairos dependency/RCA traversal on FalkorDB and can be merged into a shared traversal engine; the agent runtime, actions and connectors should be taken selectively (step-trail schema yes, unauthenticated actions no).
